يعترضن (form VIII)
# يَعْتَرِضْنَ (yaʕtariḍna) /jaʕ.ta.ridˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# يُعْتَرَضْنَ (yuʕtaraḍna) /juʕ.ta.radˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
